paper_id: Trends in Integration of Knowledge and Large Language Models_ A Survey and Taxonomy of Methods, Benchmarks, and Applications
title: Trends in Integration of Knowledge and Large Language Models: A Survey and Taxonomy of Methods, Benchmarks, and Applications
motivation: LLMs受限于过时数据和领域缺陷,缺乏全面系统综述
problem_framing: 将知识集成分为知识编辑和检索增强两类进行系统综述
key_insight: 知识编辑(改参数)与检索增强(保持参数不变)是两条互补路径
method_signature: 知识编辑与检索增强的综合分类学survey
evaluation_criteria: 知识编辑评估可靠性/泛化性/局部性
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 输入编辑方法只能增补事实,无法纠正LLM中的错误;检索文档可能含无关噪声;生成式检索无法获取实时信息
evidence_for_taste: lacking a comprehensive and systematic review
notable absence of a comprehensive survey
this direction is in an early stage
thinking_moves: 从工程痛点反推技术路径缺失
建立统一分类框架整合碎片化工作
对比知识编辑与检索增强的适用场景
